name: convex-feedback-monorepo
description: A type-safe Convex feedback component and cross-platform React UI primitives.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w convex-feedback && npm run build -w convex-feedback-ui
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w convex-feedback-example-web && npm run build -w convex-feedback-example-native && npm run build -w convex-feedback-example-expo
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples
scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:component && npm run build -w convex-feedback && npm run codegen:example
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w convex-feedback && npm run lint -w convex-feedback-ui
scripts.test: npm run test -w convex-feedback && npm run test -w convex-feedback-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w convex-feedback && npm run typecheck -w convex-feedback-ui
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.pack:ui: npm run check-version-bump:ui && npm pack -w convex-feedback-ui --dry-run
scripts.pack:component: npm run check-version-bump:component && npm pack -w convex-feedback --dry-run
